### Hawaii's first ever state championship is here!

All competitors are welcome to attend and compete. Only Hawaiian residents will be eligible for the title of Hawaii State Champion. More information can be found on the [State Champion Eligibility](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HawaiiChampionship2026#67164-state-champion-eligibility) tab.

---

##### Different days will have different events. The following days will hold the following events:
* Friday: 3x3 Fewest Moves, 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 MultiBlind
* Saturday: 3x3, 2x2, 4x4, 3x3 One-Handed, Pyraminx, Skewb
* Sunday: 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, Clock, Megaminx, Square-1, Face Turning Octahedron

**You are not required to be present on days you will not be competing.**

---

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need.
* If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial on Saturday at 9:00 AM.

**Please Note:** As this is Ireland's National Championship, only competitors who represent Ireland will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.

**Final Round Advancements:** For events with more than one round, the top 6 Irish competitors will be guaranteed to progress into the finals in addition to the top 10 remaining best competitors of any region. For 3x3 finals, the top 6 Irish competitors will be guaranteed to progress into the final in addition to the top 6 remaining best competitors of any region.

**Free T-Shirt:** All registered competitors will receive a free t-shirt. Please fill in your t-shirt size in the comment box when registering. More info [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IrishChampionship2026#70247-t-shirts)

**Fewest Moves Challenge**: FMC will not be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Rubik's Irish Championship FMC 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IrishChampionshipFMC2026/) on 11th July instead, which will be announced shortly.

## ![Español](https://i.ibb.co/R9FXtCV/spanish-flag.png) Español
   
## Bienvenido al Road to Nats Barquisimeto 2026

**Por favor leer todas las pestañas antes de registrarte, hay mucha información importante que debes saber, incluso si eres un competidor recurrente.**

* Límite de **50 competidores** para el registro.
* Es una competencia abierta, para competidores de cualquier edad y experiencia.
* **Nuevos Competidores:** hemos creado una [pestaña exclusiva](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RoadtoNatsBarquisimeto2026#77007-nuevos-competidores-new-competitor) para ustedes. Muy importante leerla.
* Si tiene dudas, contactar al equipo organizador.

#### 📸 Aviso de Filmación
Al asistir a **Road to Nats Barquisimeto 2026**, autorizas a la organización a tomar fotografías y grabar videos durante el evento. Estas imágenes podrán ser utilizadas para la promoción futura de competencias, redes sociales y sitio web oficial, transmisiones en vivo, así como para material documental y archivo histórico. Si no deseas aparecer en ninguna grabación, por favor notifícalo al equipo organizador al momento de tu registro o durante el evento. Tu participación implica la aceptación de este aviso.

## ![English](https://i.ibb.co/HT0yLMw/english-flag.png) English 
## Welcome to Road to Nats Barquisimeto 2026

**Please read all the tabs before registering; there is a lot of important information you should know, even if you are a recurring competitor.**

* Competitor registration limit: **50**.
* It is an open competition, for competitors of any age and experience.
* **New Competitors:** we have created an [exclusive tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RoadtoNatsBarquisimeto2026#77007-nuevos-competidores-new-competitor) for you. It is very important to read it.
* If you have any questions, contact the organizing team.

#### 📸 Filming Notice
By attending **Road to Nats Barquisimeto 2026**, you authorize the organization to take photographs and record videos during the event. These images may be used for future competition promotion, social media and official website, live streaming, as well as for documentary and historical archive material. If you do not wish to appear in any recording, please notify the organizing team at the time of registration or during the event. Your participation implies acceptance of this notice.
